_comment: Trigger test set for the six public skills. Each case is a real user phrasing paired with the skill that should win. The judge is any agent that can see ONLY the six name+description pairs (never the SKILL.md bodies) — that is exactly what a client sees when routing. Half the cases are Traditional Chinese because the operators and their clients ask in Chinese while every description is written in English; that mismatch is the single most likely trigger failure and must stay covered. expect_none cases must select no skill at all.
